**Finding submitted — ASSIGN: deviation (preferred-level cure proposed).**

- **Responsive language:** Section 15 (p0080) is the only assignment provision; searches for "change of control", successor/binding-effect and termination triggers returned nothing, and Sections 13–14 create no transfer-triggered rights.
- **Why it fails fallback:** no successor carve-out (an M&A or asset sale of Mortgage Logic would need TrueLink's approval), no "not unreasonably withheld" standard, and the retained no-consent affiliate exception — which also benefits TrueLink — conflicts with the fallback requirement that all other assignments require consent.
- **Cure (2 ops, minimality gate ok:true):** narrow the consent requirement to TrueLink (not unreasonably withheld, never to a Client competitor), and add a short new sentence giving Client consent-free affiliate/successor assignment and confirming no TrueLink termination right on Client's change of control. All six preferred elements mapped once each; no ancillary boilerplate added.
